# What is a minimum spanning tree?

A minimum spanning tree connects every vertex at the least total weight.[^1_1]

## Algorithms

Kruskal and Prim are the usual ones.[^1_2]

<div align="center">⁂</div>

[^1_1]: https://example.com/mst

[^1_2]: https://example.com/kruskal

---

# Which is faster on dense graphs?

Prim with an adjacency matrix runs in O(V^2).
